candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion in the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST /v1/orders 503 and gateway checkout 502s (~2s).
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side metrics or logs; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by order ReadTimeout, with postgres.save_order failing DependencyUnavailable while pool size 5 and idle 0 across all sampled requests; gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s and p95 ~2406ms. Topology confirms gateway->order->postgresql. Bounded candidate: postgres pool exhaustion in order service.
